test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six girls are sitting in a circle facing each other. Hina is sitting to the right of Mehak. Ila is to the right of Hina. Seema is on the left of Mehak, Rani is sitting between Seema and Priya. Where is Priya sitting?
solution:
**Given:** Six girls are sitting in a circle facing each other. 

1) Hina is sitting to the right of Mehak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8715a441687765cf37f86aec740fe86feea89d2505e90fc9d6d817871535a97.png] 

2) Ila is to the right of Hina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4309b57b0d4cb712cf5dc617764180c63dfc946728cb37eaa21d3dcf70437a4.png] 

3) Seema is on the left of Mehak, Rani is sitting between Seema and Priya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/444840230d654a297e5888cfb21f42f149bed55e44bb1dd1ea5cd592649c7c9e.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Priya is sitting between Ila and Rani.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
